title: libddb build artifacts
description: DDBGetBuildArtifacts (new in 2.0): one item per input path, in input order. $defs/build is also the "build" object of DDBListEntriesEx, $defs/artifact an artifact of the manifest (ddb.h, build manifest).

hash.description: SHA-256 of the file; null for a folder

source.description: Dataset-relative path of the entry the artifacts belong to (the main file of a sidecar); null when not buildable

hash.description: The hash of source, which names its build; null when not buildable

root.description: Absolute build root of source (UTF-8); null when not buildable

missingDependencies.description: From the pending marker: dataset-relative names; [] without a marker

awaitingFiles.description: The build waits for files the dataset lacks (missingDependencies is not empty): no timer retries it, adding one of them releases it; the awaitingFiles of DDBGetPendingBuildInfo; false without a marker

lastAttempt.description: From the pending marker: Unix epoch seconds (integer); null without a marker

retryAfter.description: From the pending marker: when DDBBuild with pendingOnly (and no force) retries the build, lastAttempt + libddb's retry backoff, Unix epoch seconds (integer); due when now >= retryAfter; null exactly when lastAttempt is

artifacts.description: The artifacts that exist, in the entry type's order, the primary output first

role.description: What the artifact is for (raster.cog, vector.mvt, ...); new roles are only ever added

mediaType.description: Of the file a client opens: the file, or the index of a directory

downloadName.description: File name offered for a download; absent when the artifact is not offered

index.description: The descriptor file of a directory, relative to path

legacy.description: An output of an older layout, read only; absent otherwise

fallbackFor.description: Legacy artifacts only: the role this one stands in for; listed only while that role is not

version.description: Identifies the bytes of the file a client opens (the file, the index of a directory) as they are now: lowercase hex that changes whenever a build rewrites or replaces that file, also under the same hash; opaque. Empty only when the file went away while it was read
